verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Jitsu moving data into the warehouse: event streaming, connector syncs that "pull data into your warehouse", and Profile Builder records built from events sent to Jitsu. Nothing documents defining models or audiences on existing warehouse tables and syncing them out to destinations (reverse ETL). The Functions Warehouse API (`ctx.getWarehouse`) is only a developer building block for querying inside event processing, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can run warehouse-native: define models and audiences on tables already in my warehouse and activate them without re-collecting the data (reverse ETL)
